_comment: Design-Conformance findings — copy to <Project>/QA-Documentation/design-review/findings.json and replace. Every value here is a placeholder; nothing in this file names a real project. Fields marked REQUIRED are enforced by dc-report.mjs, which refuses to build without them. Prose fields accept inline HTML (<b>, <em>, <code>) — it is rendered, not escaped.
title: <Project> Design Conformance
headline: <the one-line finding of the whole round>
standfirst: <what was compared, and the one methodological fact a reader needs before the findings>

meta.label: Status
meta.value:
Findings for owner review.
Nothing filed, nothing pushed.

sectionsBefore.title: How this was checked
sectionsBefore.lede: <the method, in one sentence — driven in a real browser, judged by what rendered>
body: <whether the bundle ships its own data-story-id annotations, and therefore whether coverage below is the design's claim or the reviewer's reading>
<whether the annotations use the spec's current numbering — i.e. whether 'the design predates the decision' is available as an explanation at all>
Standing rule for this report: two oracles disagree and this report does not pick a winner. Impact ratings are an agent hypothesis and need owner calibration.
The dot in every clip is the harness drawing where a tap landed, not part of the product.

findings._field_notes: impactClass ∈ crit | warn | ok | mute | acc — it colours the chip only. severitySource is REQUIRED whenever impact is set: 'owner' once they have rated it, otherwise 'agent-proposed'.
findings.title: <what disagrees, stated as a fact and readable on its own>
requires: REQUIRED. Given … When … Then … — quoted from the spec, never paraphrased. Paraphrase is where the reviewer's opinion leaks in, and the quote is what the owner will argue about.
observed: REQUIRED. <what the design actually does, as observed while driving it>
SCR-0nn / STORY-n.n>
notes: <anything that softens or sharpens the finding — a mitigation, a related non-finding, a second gap on the same screen>
findings.decision: <who decides, and what the two options are — 'the design catches up' vs 'the spec is amended'. The report proposes; it does not rule.>

findings.title: <a defect in the prototype build, as distinct from a spec conflict>
requires: <the AC the behaviour was judged against>
observed: <what happened instead — e.g. a page error where an explanation was specified>
notes: <why this reads as a build defect rather than a design intent — e.g. the same pattern works elsewhere in the bundle>
findings.decision: Prototype bug for the designer. No story change implied.

coverageLede: Read from the design's own annotations, not assumed. <n> of <m> stories have a reachable, annotated surface.

sectionsAfter.title: Where the design is ahead of the document
sectionsAfter.lede: Report the good news too — a conformance report that only lists failures is read as adversarial, and a stale open item stays open another month.
body: <an open gap in the spec that this design has in fact already closed>
